title: Platform App Generator
description: Scaffold a new task-management platform app from a YAML capability matrix.

name.description: The name of the platform app (used as the Nx project name and directory under apps/).
name.x-prompt: What is the platform app name? (e.g. trello, wrike, asana)

yamlFile.description: Path to the capability YAML file, relative to the workspace root.
yamlFile.x-prompt: Path to the capability YAML file (e.g. capabilities/trello.yaml)

dryRun.description: Print a structured diff of every file that would be created or modified without writing anything to disk.

update.description: Re-run on an existing app: regenerate the capabilities provider from YAML and add any new route stubs. All other scaffold files are preserved.

e2e.description: Scaffold or update the <app>-e2e Playwright project and wire nx run <app>:e2e on the main app. Requires e2e.enabled: true in the capability YAML. Does not modify capabilities provider or route stubs.

force.description: Overwrite all scaffold files, including manually edited ones. Implies --update behaviour for route stubs.

initialCommit.description: Create an initial git commit for the newly provisioned app. Only runs on first-time generation and is skipped if the repo was already dirty.
